facts.summary: Singapore has been at DORSCON Orange since 7 February 2020, after local cases appeared with no link to earlier cases or travel to China.

source.title: Risk assessment raised to DORSCON Orange

facts.summary: A new government under Prime Minister Muhyiddin Yassin was sworn in on 1 March 2020, two weeks before this crisis, after Mahathir Mohamad resigned on 24 February.

source.title: Muhyiddin takes oath as 8th PM before King

facts.summary: The Movement Control Order takes effect on 18 March 2020 and runs to 31 March, barring Malaysians from travelling abroad.

source.title: PM: Malaysia in lockdown from Wed until March 31
source.who_said_it: Malay Mail, reporting the Prime Minister's announcement
